narrative.summary: Russia adopted a framework AI law in 2026: Federal Law 243-FZ of 26 July 2026 on supporting the development of AI technologies, in force from 1 September 2026 with its main provisions (status of sovereign and national foundation models, developer duties, labelling of AI-generated content and a copyright exception for training data) applying from 1 March 2027. It builds on the National AI Development Strategy to 2030 (Presidential Decree 490 of 2019, amended in February 2024), a Presidential Commission on AI created in 2026, the Government's AI Development Centre and AI subcommission, and a 2026 roadmap for high-performance computing and AI. Experimental legal regimes are the main regulatory tool: a federal law set up the Moscow AI experiment in 2020, and 2024 amendments require commissions to investigate harm caused by AI in experimental regimes and registers of AI-created works, implemented by the Ministry of Economic Development and the Bank of Russia; self-driving vehicle and medical sandboxes are set by government resolutions. Personal data law restricts decisions based solely on automated processing and, since 2025, governs anonymised data sets for AI. The Bank of Russia has issued a Code of Ethics for AI in the financial market and AI security recommendations, medical-device rules cover AI software, FSTEC sets AI security requirements for state information systems, and Rosstandart has adopted national AI standards including ISO/IEC 42001. Moscow runs a computer-vision AI experiment in healthcare.
lead_institutions: President of the Russian Federation (Presidential Commission on AI)
Government of the Russian Federation (AI Development Centre)
Ministry of Digital Development, Communications and Mass Media
narrative.review_notes: Deep review completed on 11 October 2026, covering federal laws and presidential and government acts, federal ministries and services, the Bank of Russia and other regulators, national AI standards, and Moscow. Searches were made in Russian and English. Many Russian government websites block access from outside Russia, including the Ministry of Digital Development, the Ministry of Economic Development, Roskomnadzor, Rospatent, the antimonopoly service, the Central Election Commission, the State Duma's bill database and several regional portals; documents on those sites are held as pending, and national standards were read only from their official catalogue entries. Bills are listed as pending rather than as instruments. Pending: the AI Code of Ethics (published only by an industry alliance), Ministry of Digital Development and Ministry of Education AI documents, AI labelling and deepfake bills, Tatarstan's and Saint Petersburg's AI documents, and Moscow's own acts implementing the AI experimental regime.

instruments.english_title: Government Order No. 482-r of 12 March 2026 approving the Action Plan (Roadmap) for the Development of High-Performance Computing, Artificial Intelligence Algorithms, Grid Technologies and Supercomputer Infrastructure
instruments.current_status: Order dated 12 March 2026; official internet publication No. 0001202603160017 (16 March 2026). Current; the Ministry of Science and Higher Education reports annually by 30 September on implementation.
instruments.summary: Government roadmap of measures to develop high-performance computing, AI algorithms, grid technologies and supercomputer infrastructure, organised in system-wide, regulatory and technical, workforce and technology-development sections with deadlines and responsible bodies. It includes preparing a concept for a federal science and technology programme in these fields. The Ministry of Science and Higher Education coordinates and monitors implementation with other federal bodies, Rosatom, Rostec, Roscosmos and leading research institutions.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Sets the federal plan for AI compute and AI-algorithm research capacity.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 09.06.2025 № 861 «О Центре развития искусственного интеллекта при Правительстве Российской Федерации»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 861 of 9 June 2025 'On the Centre for the Development of Artificial Intelligence under the Government of the Russian Federation'
instruments.publisher_name: Official Internet Portal of Legal Information (Federal Guard Service of the Russian Federation)
instruments.current_status: Signed 9 June 2025 and officially published 9 June 2025 (No. 0001202506090057). No effective date is recorded.
instruments.summary: Creates the Centre for AI Development under the Government on the basis of the ANO 'Analytical Centre under the Government', responsible for information-analytical and organisational support for the Government's priority AI tasks. It approves regulations on the system for implementing those tasks, setting the Centre's functions and rights and how federal and regional executive bodies interact with it; science, research and AI education matters are excluded.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Sets up the Government's operational AI coordination centre.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 03.03.2026 № 219 «О внесении изменений в постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 7 сентября 2018 г. № 1065»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 219 of 3 March 2026 amending Resolution No. 1065 of 7 September 2018 (establishing the Subcommission on the Development and Deployment of AI Technologies, including Autonomous AI Systems)
instruments.current_status: Dated and officially published 3 March 2026 (publication No. 0001202603030014); enters into force on official publication. The Subcommission's membership was approved by Government Order No. 435-r of 6 March 2026; the list of subcommissions was further amended by Resolution No. 773 of 20 June 2026, which kept the AI subcommission.
instruments.summary: Amends the Regulation on the Government Commission on Digital Development so that its working coordinating bodies include a Subcommission on the Development and Deployment of AI Technologies, including Autonomous AI Systems. The Subcommission's composition is approved by the Government. It re-creates an AI subcommission in the Government's digital-development commission after the earlier AI subcommission was abolished in 2022.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Establishes the current inter-agency government body on AI and autonomous AI systems.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 23.11.2019 № 1500 «О внесении изменений в Положение о Правительственной комиссии по цифровому развитию, использованию информационных технологий для улучшения качества жизни и условий ведения предпринимательской деятельности и Положение о системе управления реализацией национальной программы „Цифровая экономика Российской Федерации“»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 1500 of 23 November 2019 amending the Regulation on the Government Commission on Digital Development and the Regulation on the management system of the national programme 'Digital Economy' (creating the Subcommission on AI Development)
instruments.current_status: Dated 23 November 2019 and officially published on 26 November 2019 (publication No. 0001201911260012). It was later amended by No. 864 of 13 May 2022; No. 219 of 3 March 2026 is also cited.
instruments.summary: Added a Subcommission on the Development of Artificial Intelligence to the Government Commission on Digital Development, alongside the digital-economy subcommission, with its composition approved by the Government. It also amended the management system of the national programme 'Digital Economy' accordingly. Kept for the timeline: the subcommission was abolished in May 2022.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Historical: first dedicated AI coordination body within the Government commission.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 09.03.2022 № 309 «Об установлении экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций и утверждении Программы экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций по эксплуатации высокоавтоматизированных транспортных средств»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 309 of 9 March 2022 establishing an experimental legal regime in digital innovation and approving its Programme for the operation of highly automated vehicles
instruments.current_status: Dated 9 March 2022; officially published 17 March 2022 (No. 0001202203170018). Three-year regime extended to 1 April 2028 by Resolution No. 373 of 27 March 2025. In force.
instruments.summary: Sets up a regulatory sandbox (experimental legal regime) for testing highly automated (self-driving) vehicles, including category 1 vehicles in Moscow, Innopolis (Tatarstan) and the Sirius federal territory, and category 2 vehicles in Innopolis and Skolkovo. The Programme lists neurotechnologies and AI (computer vision, decision support) among the technologies used, requires insurance and conformity conclusions from a testing laboratory for each vehicle, and sets operating zones and participant obligations.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: AI sandbox for autonomous driving under the experimental legal regimes law.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 17.10.2022 № 1849 «Об установлении экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций и утверждении Программы экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций по эксплуатации высокоавтоматизированных транспортных средств в отношении реализации инициативы „Беспилотные логистические коридоры“ на автомобильной дороге общего пользования федерального значения М-11 „Нева“»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 1849 of 17 October 2022 establishing an experimental legal regime for highly automated vehicles under the 'Unmanned Logistics Corridors' initiative on the M-11 'Neva' federal highway
instruments.current_status: Dated 17 October 2022; officially published 20 October 2022 (No. 0001202210200037). Extended by Resolution No. 1790 of 13 November 2025 (official publication title). In force.
instruments.summary: Establishes a regulatory sandbox for operating highly automated trucks on the M-11 'Neva' Moscow-Saint Petersburg federal highway under the 'Unmanned Logistics Corridors' initiative. The Programme defines automated driving systems and automated control mode, and covers design, production and operation of highly automated vehicles, operator certification and transport and logistics services.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: AI-driven freight autonomy sandbox on a federal highway.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 29.12.2022 № 2495 «Об установлении экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых и технологических инноваций и утверждении Программы экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых и технологических инноваций по предоставлению транспортных услуг с использованием высокоавтоматизированных транспортных средств на территориях отдельных субъектов Российской Федерации»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 2495 of 29 December 2022 establishing an experimental legal regime for transport services using highly automated vehicles in selected regions (robotaxi sandbox)
instruments.current_status: Dated 29 December 2022; officially published 30 December 2022 (No. 0001202212300090). Title and term amended by Resolution No. 1955 of 28 November 2025, which extended the regime to 28 December 2028; further amended 30 March 2026 (No. 347). In force.
instruments.summary: Regulatory sandbox allowing transport services (including passenger services) using highly automated vehicles in over 30 federal subjects, among them Tatarstan, Krasnodar, Moscow, Leningrad, Novosibirsk and Sverdlovsk regions. The Programme lists neurotechnologies and AI, including computer vision and decision support, among the technologies applied, and sets participant and operating requirements.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Main nationwide sandbox for commercial autonomous-vehicle services.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 25.07.2024 № 1006 «Об установлении экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций и утверждении Программы экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций по предоставлению транспортных услуг с использованием высокоавтоматизированных рельсовых транспортных средств (трамваев)»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 1006 of 25 July 2024 establishing an experimental legal regime for transport services using highly automated rail vehicles (trams)
instruments.current_status: Dated 25 July 2024; officially published 26 July 2024 (No. 0001202407260008); enters into force on official publication; three-year term. Amended 9 August 2025 (No. 1184). In force.
instruments.summary: Regulatory sandbox for passenger services using highly automated (driverless) trams for three years from entry into force. The Programme defines operating zones on tram tracks, test engineers and drivers, and lists neurotechnologies and AI, including computer vision and decision support, among the technologies applied.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: AI-enabled autonomous public-transport sandbox.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 09.12.2022 № 2276 «Об установлении экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций и утверждении Программы экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций по направлению медицинской деятельности с применением технологий сбора и обработки сведений о состоянии здоровья и диагнозов граждан в отношении реализации инициативы социально-экономического развития Российской Федерации „Персональные медицинские помощники“»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 2276 of 9 December 2022 establishing an experimental legal regime in medical activity using health-data collection and processing technologies under the 'Personal Medical Assistants' initiative
instruments.current_status: Dated 9 December 2022; officially published 15 December 2022 (No. 0001202212150019). Amended in 2023 and 2024 (latest 11 December 2024, No. 1754). In force.
instruments.summary: Healthcare regulatory sandbox for remote monitoring of patients with registered medical devices that transmit readings such as blood pressure and glucose. Its Programme covers software that is a medical device processing remote-monitoring data, including software using AI that supports clinicians' decisions.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Health sandbox covering AI clinical decision-support software for remote monitoring.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 30.11.2024 № 1684 «Об утверждении Правил государственной регистрации медицинских изделий»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 1684 of 30 November 2024 approving the Rules for State Registration of Medical Devices
instruments.current_status: Officially published 30.11.2024 (publication.pravo.gov.ru 0001202411300042). In force from 1 March 2025 (sub-para 'e' of para 137 from 1 September 2025). As adopted, the Rules applied until 31 December 2026 and paras 63, 87 and 101 until 31 December 2025; Government Resolution No. 2214 of 30.12.2025 (in force 8 January 2026) extended the Rules to 31 December 2028 and applies paras 63, 87 and 101 until 31 December 2027. General medical-device rules with explicit AI provisions.
instruments.summary: New rules for state registration of medical devices, administered by Roszdravnadzor. Paragraph 87 requires an applicant registering a device whose effectiveness does not need clinical trials with human participation to state whether software using AI technologies that is a medical device has a built-in function for automatically transferring data on processed data and results of the software's operation to the regulator's information system, under a procedure set by the regulator, together with adverse-event reporting information.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Legal basis for Roszdravnadzor's automatic monitoring of AI medical software.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 24.11.2020 № 1906 «О внесении изменений в Правила государственной регистрации медицинских изделий»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 1906 of 24 November 2020 amending the Rules for State Registration of Medical Devices (AI software provisions)
instruments.current_status: Dated 24 November 2020; officially published 27 November 2020 (No. 0001202011270010). Declared invalid by Government Resolution No. 1684 of 30 November 2024.
instruments.summary: Amended the 2012 medical-device registration rules to refer expressly to software that is a medical device, including software using AI technologies, in registration dossier requirements and procedures. It was the first government act to name AI software within medical-device registration. Kept for the timeline.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Historical: first explicit AI-software provisions in medical-device registration.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Российской Федерации от 01.08.2025 № 1154 «Об утверждении требований к обезличиванию персональных данных, методов обезличивания персональных данных и Правил обезличивания персональных данных»
instruments.english_title: Government Resolution No. 1154 of 1 August 2025 approving requirements for anonymisation of personal data, anonymisation methods and anonymisation rules
instruments.current_status: Dated 1 August 2025; officially published 5 August 2025 (No. 0001202508050011); in force from 1 September 2025. Agreed with the FSB.
instruments.summary: Sets requirements, methods and rules for anonymising personal data under Article 13.1 of the Personal Data Law, including when operators receive requests from the Ministry of Digital Development to provide anonymised data. It expressly covers anonymisation for Moscow's government under Article 6.2 of the federal law on the AI experimental regime in Moscow (regional data compositions for AI development).
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Implements the anonymised-data pathway created for AI development datasets.

instruments.official_title: Приказ Министерства экономического развития Российской Федерации от 29.06.2021 № 392 «Об утверждении критериев определения принадлежности проектов к проектам в сфере искусственного интеллекта»
instruments.english_title: Order of the Ministry of Economic Development No. 392 of 29 June 2021 approving criteria for determining whether projects belong to the field of artificial intelligence
instruments.current_status: Dated 29 June 2021; registered with the Ministry of Justice 28 July 2021 (No. 64430); officially published 29 July 2021 (No. 0001202107290008). No amendment shown on the portal.
instruments.summary: Sets three criteria (project subject, base technology and result) for deciding whether a project is an AI project eligible for federal support for AI pilot projects under Government Resolution No. 767 of 2021. It defines AI technologies by reference to the National AI Strategy (computer vision, natural language processing, speech recognition and synthesis, intelligent decision support and advanced AI methods) and lists qualifying results such as AI software, AI chips and dataset creation and processing.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Operational definition of 'AI project' used for federal AI funding.

instruments.official_title: Приказ Министерства экономического развития Российской Федерации от 26.11.2024 № 752 «Об утверждении Порядка формирования комиссии для установления обстоятельств, при которых при реализации экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций в результате использования решений, разработанных с применением технологий искусственного интеллекта, причинен вред жизни, здоровью или имуществу человека либо имуществу юридического лица, Порядка рассмотрения комиссией случаев причинения вреда жизни, здоровью или имуществу человека либо имуществу юридического лица при реализации экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций в результате использования решений, разработанных с применением технологий искусственного интеллекта, Порядка подготовки заключения комиссии по итогам установления обстоятельств, при которых в результате реализации экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций при использовании решений, разработанных с применением технологий искусственного интеллекта, был причинен вред жизни, здоровью или имуществу человека либо имуществу юридического лица, формы такого заключения»
instruments.english_title: Order of the Ministry of Economic Development No. 752 of 26 November 2024 on the commission investigating harm caused by AI solutions in experimental legal regimes (formation, procedure, conclusion and its form)
instruments.current_status: Dated 26 November 2024; registered with the Ministry of Justice 26 December 2024 (No. 80786); officially published 27 December 2024 (No. 0001202412270024). Enters into force on the day Federal Law No. 169-FZ of 8 July 2024 enters into force.
instruments.summary: Implements Article 18.1 of the Federal Law on experimental legal regimes (added by Law No. 169-FZ of 2024) by setting how a commission is formed to establish the circumstances in which AI solutions used in a regulatory sandbox caused harm to life, health or property. It sets the commission's composition (approved by the regulating body), how it examines harm cases, how it prepares its conclusion, and the conclusion form. It applies to all experimental-regime directions except the one in item 4 of Article 1(2) of the law.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Russia's procedure for investigating AI-caused harm in regulatory sandboxes.

instruments.official_title: Приказ Министерства экономического развития Российской Федерации от 19.11.2024 № 725 «Об утверждении Порядка ведения реестра результатов интеллектуальной деятельности, создаваемых в том числе с применением технологий искусственного интеллекта при реализации экспериментального правового режима в сфере цифровых инноваций, с указанием их правообладателей и обеспечения доступа к нему третьих лиц»
instruments.english_title: Order of the Ministry of Economic Development No. 725 of 19 November 2024 on the register of intellectual-property results created, including with AI, in experimental legal regimes
instruments.current_status: Dated 19 November 2024; registered with the Ministry of Justice 20 December 2024 (No. 80673); officially published 23 December 2024 (No. 0001202412230009). Enters into force on the day Federal Law No. 169-FZ of 8 July 2024 enters into force.
instruments.summary: Requires each participant in a regulatory sandbox to keep an electronic register of intellectual-property results created during the regime, including those created with AI, naming the right holders and giving third parties access. Register entries must include the result, a description of the AI technology used to create it (if any) and the right holder.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Transparency and IP-attribution rule for AI-generated outputs in sandboxes.

instruments.official_title: Приказ Федеральной службы по надзору в сфере здравоохранения от 21.07.2025 № 4472 «Об утверждении Порядка автоматической передачи в автоматизированную информационную систему Федеральной службы по надзору в сфере здравоохранения информации об обрабатываемых данных, результатах действия программного обеспечения с применением технологий искусственного интеллекта, являющегося медицинским изделием, подлежащим обращению на территории Российской Федерации»

instruments.publisher_name: Federal Service for Surveillance in Healthcare
instruments.current_status: Dated 21.07.2025; registered by the Ministry of Justice 14.10.2025 No. 83837; officially published 14.10.2025. By its own para 2 it applied until 31 December 2025. Replaced by Roszdravnadzor Order No. 123 of 10.02.2026 approving a procedure with the same title. Commencement date not stated in the order.
instruments.summary: Approved, under para 87 of the medical-device registration rules, the procedure by which manufacturers of AI software that is a medical device and has a built-in automatic data-transfer function send Roszdravnadzor's automated information system data on the data processed and the results produced by the software. Valid until the end of 2025.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First post-market monitoring rule for AI medical software in Russia.

instruments.official_title: Приказ Федеральной службы по надзору в сфере здравоохранения от 10.02.2026 № 123 «Об утверждении Порядка автоматической передачи в автоматизированную информационную систему Федеральной службы по надзору в сфере здравоохранения информации об обрабатываемых данных, результатах действия программного обеспечения с применением технологий искусственного интеллекта, являющегося медицинским изделием, подлежащим обращению на территории Российской Федерации»
instruments.english_title: Roszdravnadzor Order No. 123 of 10 February 2026 approving the procedure for automatic transfer to Roszdravnadzor's information system of data on processed data and results of AI software that is a medical device
instruments.issuing_authority: Federal Service for Surveillance in Healthcare
instruments.publisher_name: Federal Service for Surveillance in Healthcare
instruments.current_status: Dated 10.02.2026; registered by the Ministry of Justice 08.05.2026 No. 86377; officially published 12.05.2026. Valid until 31 December 2027 (para 2). Issued under paras 3 and 87 of the medical-device registration rules and para 2 of Government Resolution No. 2214 of 30.12.2025. Successor to Order No. 4472 of 21.07.2025. Commencement date not stated in the order.
instruments.summary: Requires the manufacturer (or authorised representative) of AI software that is a medical device and has a built-in automatic data-transfer function to transmit automatically to the 'AIS Roszdravnadzor' information system data on the data processed and results of the device, through a separate electronic applicant account per device accessed via the ESIA identity system. Transfers must include the device name and registration certificate, version, field of use, decision type, number of studies or objects processed, results, the number of errors (network, data-quality and device-operation errors) and the taxpayer number of the medical organisation using the device.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Current binding post-market performance-monitoring rule for AI medical devices.

instruments.english_title: Consultation paper 'Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Financial Market'
instruments.current_status: Published 3 November 2023 for public consultation; comments invited to ai_doklad@cbr.ru until 15 December 2023. The consultation closed; the Bank of Russia published a report on its results on 22 May 2024. Prepared by the Department of Financial Technologies and the Department of Strategic Development of the Financial Market.
instruments.summary: Bank of Russia consultation paper on how AI, including generative AI and large language models, is used in the Russian financial market (scoring, underwriting, trading, advice, risk management, anti-fraud), the conditions for its development, and its technological, economic, ethical and information-security risks. It reviews foreign regulatory approaches and proposes a risk-based, technology-neutral approach, stating that rapid adoption of special rules for financial institutions' use of AI systems is not needed at present, and poses questions to market participants.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First Bank of Russia document setting out its supervisory approach to AI in finance.

instruments.official_title: Отчет об итогах публичного обсуждения доклада для общественных консультаций «Применение искусственного интеллекта на финансовом рынке»
instruments.english_title: Report on the results of the public discussion of the consultation paper 'Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Financial Market'
instruments.current_status: Published 22 May 2024 on cbr.ru together with a news item. Closes the 2023 consultation; followed by the 2025 consultation paper on the current status of AI in the financial market.
instruments.summary: Summarises the 33 responses (15 credit institutions, 6 insurers and 12 associations, universities, infrastructure organisations and AI developers) to the Bank of Russia's November 2023 AI consultation paper, covering technologies and trends, applications in finance, conditions for AI development, risks and regulatory approaches. It records market support for the Bank's assessment and states that the Bank will promote AI development while keeping a risk-based approach to its use.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Sets the Bank of Russia's post-consultation position that led to the 2025 AI Code of Ethics.

instruments.official_title: Информационное письмо Банка России о Кодексе этики в сфере разработки и применения искусственного интеллекта на финансовом рынке от 09.07.2025 № ИН-016-13/91
instruments.english_title: Bank of Russia Information Letter No. IN-016-13/91 of 9 July 2025 on the Code of Ethics for the Development and Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Financial Market
instruments.current_status: Information letter IN-016-13/91 dated 9 July 2025, published with the Code on cbr.ru on 9 July 2025; it is recommendatory and current. In May 2026 the Bank of Russia said it would prepare, with market participants, a compendium of best practices for compliance with the Code.
instruments.summary: Information letter by which the Bank of Russia recommends that credit institutions, foreign bank branches, non-credit financial organisations, professional financial-market service providers and national payment system entities apply its Code of Ethics when developing and using AI, especially in services to clients. The annexed Code sets five principles (human-centricity; fairness; transparency; safety, reliability and effectiveness; responsible risk management) with measures such as letting clients opt out of AI interaction and have AI decisions reviewed by an employee, informing clients of AI use where it is not obvious, disclosing information about AI, labelling information created with large generative models, not using factors such as nationality, language, race, political affiliation or religion in AI decisions, using personal data only where justified, and managing AI risks.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Main soft-law instrument governing AI use by Russian financial institutions.

It proposes further soft regulation building on the 2025 Code of Ethics and measures to make data more available to AI developers in finance, such as trusted data-sharing intermediaries and privacy-enhancing technologies, and poses consultation questions.

instruments.official_title: Методические рекомендации Банка России по обеспечению информационной безопасности при разработке и применении искусственного интеллекта на финансовом рынке от 16.06.2026 № 3-МР
instruments.english_title: Bank of Russia Methodological Recommendations No. 3-MR of 16 June 2026 on Ensuring Information Security in the Development and Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Financial Market
instruments.current_status: No. 3-MR of 16.06.2026, listed on the Bank of Russia information-security legal acts page; announced 16 June 2026. Recommendatory; implements the security principle of the 2025 Code of Ethics. Current.
instruments.summary: Recommendations to credit institutions, foreign bank branches, non-credit financial organisations, professional service providers and payment system entities on managing information-security and operational-reliability risks of AI, implementing the Code of Ethics principle of safety, reliability and effectiveness. They define threats such as AI hallucinations, data drift, direct and indirect prompt injection and poisoned datasets, and recommend AI-specific threat models, protective measures, an AI information-security policy (covering inventory of open-source models, agents and plugins, output marking, incident response, emergency shutdown and outsourcing assessment), employee confirmation of AI-driven operations in critical high-risk processes such as payments, and controls on third-party AI services.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First Bank of Russia document systematising AI security risks and attack tactics for financial institutions.

instruments.english_title: Bank of Russia Ordinance No. 7120-U of 30 June 2025 on the commission to establish the circumstances of harm caused by AI-based solutions under an experimental legal regime for digital innovation in the financial market, its procedure and the form of its conclusion
instruments.current_status: Dated 30.06.2025; registered by the Ministry of Justice 14.10.2025 No. 83832; officially published on cbr.ru 20.10.2025. Enters into force 10 days after the day of official publication (effective_date computed from that clause). Issued under art. 18.1 of Federal Law No. 258-FZ of 31.07.2020 on experimental legal regimes.
instruments.summary: Sets how the Bank of Russia forms a commission of at least seven members (chair, deputy and secretary from Bank staff, plus other interested persons such as regime participants, but not the regime subject concerned) to investigate cases where AI-based solutions used under a financial-market experimental legal regime cause harm to a person's life, health or property or to a legal entity's property. It sets the procedure for the commission's examination and the form of its conclusion, which covers the circumstances of the harm (including technical failures or errors in developing or deploying the AI), whether measures to remedy or prevent harm are needed, and whether the regime should be changed or the subject's status suspended.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Binding liability-investigation mechanism for AI harms inside the Bank of Russia's experimental legal regimes.

instruments.publisher_name: Federal Service for Technical and Export Control
instruments.current_status: Dated 11.04.2025; registered by the Ministry of Justice 16.06.2025 No. 82619; officially published 17.06.2025. In force from 1 March 2026 (para 4), replacing FSTEC Order No. 17 of 11.02.2013. Amended by FSTEC Order No. 137 of 08.05.2026 (in force 1 September 2026; not AI-related). General information-security requirements with explicit AI provisions (paras 60-61).
instruments.summary: Information-protection requirements for state information systems and other systems of state bodies, unitary enterprises and institutions, replacing FSTEC Order No. 17. Paragraphs 60-61 require operators using AI to prevent unauthorised access to and interference with training data, models, parameters and processing, prohibit transferring restricted information to the developer of the AI model (including for improving the model), require query and answer templates or permitted topics and formats for user interaction with AI services, statistical criteria to detect unreliable AI answers and a response that limits AI decisions, exclusion of unregulated influence on model parameters, and use of trusted AI technologies.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Binding AI security rules for public-sector information systems.

instruments.official_title: Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 10.10.2019 № 490 «О развитии искусственного интеллекта в Российской Федерации»
instruments.english_title: Presidential Decree No. 490 of 10 October 2019 'On the Development of Artificial Intelligence in the Russian Federation', approving the National Strategy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence to 2030 (as amended by Decree No. 124 of 15 February 2024)
instruments.current_status: Signed 10 October 2019, in force from signing; officially published 11 October 2019 (publication No. 0001201910110003). The kremlin.ru text is the consolidated version 'as amended by Presidential Decree No. 124 of 15.02.2024'. Approved by presidential decree (a binding act for executive bodies); the Strategy itself is a strategic planning document. Current.
instruments.summary: Presidential decree approving the National AI Development Strategy to 2030, in the consolidated text as amended by Decree No. 124 of 15 February 2024. The amended Strategy defines AI, large generative models and 'trusted AI technologies', sets 2030 targets (e.g. AI computing capacity of at least 1 exaflop, cumulative GDP gain from AI of at least 11.2 trillion roubles) and provides for mandatory introduction of trusted AI in areas of use that may harm security. The decree instructs the Government to fold the federal project 'Artificial Intelligence' into the national project on the data economy by 1 July 2024, report annually to the President, and directs federal executive bodies to follow the Strategy in sectoral strategic planning.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Russia's top-level AI policy instrument; Federal Law No. 243-FZ of 2026 confirms that the President approves the National AI Development Strategy.

instruments.official_title: Национальная стратегия развития искусственного интеллекта на период до 2030 года (утверждена Указом Президента Российской Федерации от 10.10.2019 № 490, первоначальная редакция)
instruments.english_title: National Strategy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence to 2030 (approved by Presidential Decree No. 490 of 10 October 2019, original 2019 text)
instruments.publisher_name: Official Internet Portal of Legal Information (Federal Guard Service of the Russian Federation)
instruments.current_status: Original text as officially published on 11 October 2019 (publication No. 0001201910110003). Amended by Presidential Decree No. 124 of 15 February 2024 (in force from signing), which revised the Strategy; the amended text is recorded separately.
instruments.summary: The National AI Development Strategy to 2030 as originally approved by Presidential Decree No. 490 in October 2019. It set goals and tasks for AI research, software, data availability, hardware, personnel and the regulatory system, with milestones for 2024 and 2030, and instructed the Government to amend the national programme 'Digital Economy of the Russian Federation' and approve a federal project 'Artificial Intelligence' by 15 December 2019.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Original version of Russia's first national AI strategy, kept for the timeline; substantially rewritten by Decree No. 124 of 15 February 2024.

instruments.official_title: Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 15.02.2024 № 124 «О внесении изменений в Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 10 октября 2019 г. № 490 "О развитии искусственного интеллекта в Российской Федерации" и в Национальную стратегию, утвержденную этим Указом»
instruments.english_title: Presidential Decree No. 124 of 15 February 2024 amending Decree No. 490 'On the Development of Artificial Intelligence in the Russian Federation' and the National AI Development Strategy approved by it
instruments.current_status: Signed and in force 15 February 2024 ('вступает в силу со дня его подписания'); officially published 15 February 2024 (publication No. 0001202402150063). Its amendments are incorporated into the consolidated text of Decree No. 490.
instruments.summary: Amending decree that rewrites the National AI Development Strategy to 2030: it adds definitions of large generative models, strong AI and trusted AI technologies, records progress since 2019 (including the AI Ethics Code and 'soft law'), and sets new 2030 targets and a subsection on introducing trusted AI in public authorities. It also obliges federal executive bodies to follow the Strategy in sectoral strategic planning documents, recommends that regions, municipalities and state corporations do the same, and requires the federal project 'Artificial Intelligence' to be included in the national data-economy project by 1 July 2024.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: The 2024 overhaul of the national AI strategy, adding generative AI and trusted-AI provisions.

instruments.official_title: Указ Президента Российской Федерации от 26.02.2026 № 116 «О Комиссии при Президенте Российской Федерации по вопросам развития технологий искусственного интеллекта»
instruments.english_title: Presidential Decree No. 116 of 26 February 2026 'On the Presidential Commission on the Development of Artificial Intelligence Technologies'
instruments.current_status: Signed and in force 26 February 2026 (from signing); officially published 26 February 2026 (publication No. 0001202602260005). Current. Many regions have since issued acts forming regional AI commissions.
instruments.summary: Establishes the Commission under the President on AI technology development and approves its regulations and membership. The Commission coordinates federal bodies, the Bank of Russia and regions on AI policy, sets and assesses AI target indicators, develops measures for technological leadership (including Russian large foundation models, computing capacity and electronic components), defines directions for improving AI legal regulation and analyses AI risks and threats; it meets at least quarterly under two co-chairs. Regional heads are recommended to form regional interdepartmental AI commissions by 1 June 2026.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Creates the top-level national AI governance body, coordinating policy across federal, regional and central-bank actors.

instruments.official_title: Федеральный закон от 26.07.2026 № 243-ФЗ «О поддержке развития технологий искусственного интеллекта в Российской Федерации»
instruments.english_title: Federal Law No. 243-FZ of 26 July 2026 'On Support for the Development of Artificial Intelligence Technologies in the Russian Federation'
instruments.issuing_authority: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
instruments.current_status: Adopted by the State Duma 8 July 2026, approved by the Federation Council 17 July 2026, signed 26 July 2026 and officially published 26 July 2026 (publication No. 0001202607260003). In force from 1 September 2026, except art. 5(2)(3)-(5), art. 6(2)-(5) and arts. 8-10 (sovereign/national model status, developer duties, labelling, IP rules), which apply from 1 March 2027. Systems already using large foundation models are exempt from exclusive-use requirements until 1 September 2032 if data are processed and stored in Russia.
instruments.summary: Russia's first framework AI law, governing the development, deployment and use of large foundation AI models (at least 1 billion parameters). It defines AI and large foundation models, sets principles including a risk-based approach and respect for 'traditional Russian spiritual and moral values', creates 'sovereign' and 'national' model status (Russian-controlled developer, in-country data centres, conformity confirmation), lets the Government require exclusive use of such models in specified cases and set sector risk requirements, and imposes security, documentation and operating-rule duties on their developers. It requires large platforms (over 500,000 daily Russian users) to let users label AI-generated content, obliges model providers to tell users about rights to AI outputs, and allows text-and-data analysis of lawfully obtained works for training sovereign and national models.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Comprehensive federal AI statute: model status regime, developer obligations, AI-content labelling and a training-data copyright exception.

instruments.official_title: Федеральный закон от 24.04.2020 № 123-ФЗ «О проведении эксперимента по установлению специального регулирования в целях создания необходимых условий для разработки и внедрения технологий искусственного интеллекта в субъекте Российской Федерации - городе федерального значения Москве и внесении изменений в статьи 6 и 10 Федерального закона "О персональных данных"»
instruments.english_title: Federal Law No. 123-FZ of 24 April 2020 on an experiment establishing special regulation to create conditions for developing and introducing AI technologies in the federal city of Moscow, and amending articles 6 and 10 of the Federal Law 'On Personal Data'
instruments.issuing_authority: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
instruments.current_status: Adopted by the State Duma 14 April 2020, approved by the Federation Council 17 April 2020, signed 24 April 2020, officially published 24 April 2020 (No. 0001202004240030); in force 1 July 2020 (art. 8). Art. 1(3) sets the regime for five years from 1 July 2020; no amendment extending that term was found in the gazette title search. Amended by Federal Law No. 233-FZ of 8 August 2024 (new title and rules on regional data sets, from 1 September 2025). The kremlin.ru text is the original 2020 version. Recorded at national level because it is a federal law, although the regime applies in Moscow.
instruments.summary: Establishes a five-year experimental legal regime (from 1 July 2020) in Moscow for developing and introducing AI technologies, with Moscow's government as the authorised body setting the regime's conditions, a coordination council and a register of participants. It defines AI and AI technologies in law for the first time and lets participants receive personal data anonymised by operators for the experiment, amending the Personal Data Law accordingly. The regime may not restrict constitutional rights or add duties for citizens.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First AI-specific federal statute; created the Moscow AI regulatory sandbox and the legal AI definition later reused in federal law.

instruments.official_title: Федеральный закон от 31.07.2020 № 258-ФЗ «Об экспериментальных правовых режимах в сфере цифровых и технологических инноваций в Российской Федерации»
instruments.english_title: Federal Law No. 258-FZ of 31 July 2020 'On Experimental Legal Regimes in the Field of Digital and Technological Innovations in the Russian Federation' (as amended)
instruments.issuing_authority: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
instruments.current_status: Adopted by the State Duma 22 July 2020, approved 24 July 2020, signed and officially published 31 July 2020 (No. 0001202007310024). Art. 20: enters into force 180 days after official publication (exact date not stated in the text). kremlin.ru shows the consolidated text as amended by laws No. 331-FZ (2021), 169-FZ and 223-FZ (2024), 523-FZ of 28.12.2024 (which renamed it to cover 'digital and technological innovations'), 336-FZ of 31.07.2025 and 211-FZ of 26.06.2026 (which, among other things, extended the maximum regime term from three to five years).
instruments.summary: Framework law for regulatory sandboxes ('experimental legal regimes') in which the Government can suspend general rules for participants testing digital innovations in listed areas, including medicine, transport and drones, finance, remote sales, construction, public services and industry. As amended in 2024, regime programmes must cover use of intellectual property created with AI and liability insurance for harm caused by AI solutions, subjects must keep registers of persons using AI solutions and of AI-created IP, and art. 18.1 requires a commission to investigate cases where AI solutions cause harm to life, health or property.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Russia's general sandbox law; the main legal channel for testing AI (including autonomous vehicles) and, since 2024, for AI-harm liability rules.

instruments.official_title: Федеральный закон от 08.07.2024 № 169-ФЗ «О внесении изменений в Федеральный закон "Об экспериментальных правовых режимах в сфере цифровых инноваций в Российской Федерации"»
instruments.english_title: Federal Law No. 169-FZ of 8 July 2024 amending the Federal Law 'On Experimental Legal Regimes in the Field of Digital Innovations in the Russian Federation' (liability for harm caused by AI)
instruments.issuing_authority: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
instruments.current_status: Adopted by the State Duma 25 June 2024, approved by the Federation Council 3 July 2024, signed and officially published 8 July 2024 (No. 0001202407080020). Art. 2: in force 180 days after official publication (exact date not stated). Implemented by Ministry of Economic Development orders No. 725 and No. 752 of November 2024 (listed under Leads). Amendments incorporated in the consolidated text of Law No. 258-FZ.
instruments.summary: Amends Law No. 258-FZ to address harm caused by AI within experimental legal regimes. Regime programmes must set conditions for using IP created with AI and mandatory civil liability insurance for harm caused by AI solutions; regime subjects must keep registers of persons using AI solutions (with their insurance) and of AI-created IP. A new art. 18.1 requires the regulator to form, within 30 days of detecting harm caused by an AI solution, a commission that reports on the extent and causes of the harm (including technical failures and developer errors) and may recommend suspending the subject; its conclusion can be challenged in court.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Introduced Russia's first statutory mechanism for investigating and insuring against harm caused by AI systems.

instruments.official_title: Федеральный закон от 27.07.2006 № 152-ФЗ «О персональных данных»
instruments.english_title: Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27 July 2006 'On Personal Data' (as amended)
instruments.issuing_authority: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
instruments.current_status: Signed 27 July 2006 (date on the kremlin.ru record); art. 25: in force 180 days after official publication. kremlin.ru shows the consolidated text as amended up to Federal Law No. 265-FZ of 26.07.2026, including No. 123-FZ (2020), No. 233-FZ (2024), No. 23-FZ (28.02.2025) and others. Art. 16 is in the wording of Law No. 261-FZ of 25.07.2011. Publication date recorded as the date of the law; the original newspaper publication date was not checked.
instruments.summary: Russia's general personal data law, binding state bodies, municipalities, companies and individuals that process personal data. Art. 16 prohibits decisions producing legal effects or otherwise affecting a data subject's rights based solely on automated processing, except with the subject's written consent or where federal law provides safeguards, and requires operators to explain the procedure and consequences, accept objections and answer them within 30 days. Art. 13.1 (added by Law No. 233-FZ, from 1 September 2025) governs anonymised personal data sets formed by the Ministry of Digital Development, including for AI development.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Governs AI training and automated decision-making on personal data; art. 16 is Russia's rule on solely automated decisions.

instruments.official_title: Федеральный закон от 08.08.2024 № 233-ФЗ «О внесении изменений в Федеральный закон "О персональных данных" и Федеральный закон "О проведении эксперимента по установлению специального регулирования в целях создания необходимых условий для разработки и внедрения технологий искусственного интеллекта в субъекте Российской Федерации - городе федерального значения Москве и внесении изменений в статьи 6 и 10 Федерального закона "О персональных данных""»
instruments.english_title: Federal Law No. 233-FZ of 8 August 2024 amending the Federal Law 'On Personal Data' and the Federal Law on the AI experiment in Moscow (anonymised personal data sets)
instruments.issuing_authority: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
instruments.current_status: Adopted by the State Duma 30 July 2024, approved by the Federation Council 2 August 2024, signed and officially published 8 August 2024 (No. 0001202408080031). In force from publication, except art. 1 paras 1-3 and 5 and art. 2 (the data-set provisions), which apply from 1 September 2025.
instruments.summary: Adds art. 13.1 to the Personal Data Law: in cases set by the Government, the Ministry of Digital Development may require operators to anonymise personal data under Government-set methods (agreed with the FSB) and deliver it to a state information system, where it is grouped into 'data sets' for public administration and other legally specified purposes, with access governed by Government rules. Special-category and biometric data are excluded. It also amends Law No. 123-FZ to cover regional data sets in Moscow.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Creates the legal basis for state-run anonymised data sets used for AI development and public administration.

instruments.official_title: Распоряжение Правительства Российской Федерации от 19.08.2020 № 2129-р «Об утверждении Концепции развития регулирования отношений в сфере технологий искусственного интеллекта и робототехники до 2024 года»
instruments.english_title: Government Order No. 2129-r of 19 August 2020 approving the Concept for the Development of Regulation of Relations in the Field of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Technologies to 2024
instruments.publisher_name: Official Internet Portal of Legal Information (Federal Guard Service of the Russian Federation)
instruments.current_status: Signed 19 August 2020; officially published 26 August 2020 (No. 0001202008260005). The Concept's horizon was 2024. No successor concept approved by the Government was found as of 11 October 2026; a draft concept to 2030 from the Ministry of Digital Development is listed under Leads.
instruments.summary: Government order approving the Concept for regulating AI and robotics technologies to 2024, which notes the absence of AI-specific legislation and aims for a regulatory environment balancing the interests of people, society, the state and developers. It directs federal executive bodies and Roscosmos to follow the Concept in policy and rule-making and to submit implementation proposals to the Ministry of Economic Development within three months under the national programme 'Digital Economy'.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Russia's first government-level AI regulatory concept; its horizon ended in 2024.

instruments.official_title: Постановление Правительства Москвы от 22.12.2023 № 2662-ПП «О продолжении проведения эксперимента по использованию инновационных технологий в области компьютерного зрения для анализа медицинских изображений и дальнейшего применения этих технологий в системе здравоохранения»
instruments.english_title: Moscow Government Resolution No. 2662-PP of 22 December 2023 on continuing the experiment on the use of innovative computer-vision technologies for medical image analysis and their further application in the healthcare system
instruments.current_status: Signed 22 December 2023, published on mos.ru 26 December 2023, in force from 1 January 2024 (para. 6). Repealed the original experiment resolution No. 1543-PP of 21 November 2019 and its amendments (No. 464-PP of 2020, 47-PP and 744-PP of 2021, 225-PP of 2022, 239-PP of 2023). The detailed procedure and conditions are approved by the Moscow Department of Health (not recorded; not found on an official page).
instruments.scope: Legal entities taking part in the Moscow computer-vision experiment in healthcare, and the Moscow Department of Health
instruments.summary: Continues, from 1 January 2024, the Moscow experiment begun in 2019 on using computer-vision services to analyse medical images in the city's healthcare system, with grants paid to participating legal entities. The Moscow Department of Health must approve the procedure and conditions, including requirements for participants and their computer-vision services, application rules and grounds for exclusion; grants are calculated from the number of diagnostic studies analysed and paid under grant agreements. Existing participants as of 31 December 2023 are carried over without reapplying.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: City-level legal framework for testing and paying for AI (computer-vision) services in radiology, setting requirements for AI services used in Moscow public healthcare.

organizations.name: Ministry of Economic Development
organizations.ai_governance_role: Federal ministry responsible for experimental legal regimes (regulatory sandboxes) in digital innovation, including AI harm-investigation and AI-generated IP registry procedures, and AI project criteria under the federal project 'Artificial Intelligence'.

organizations.ai_governance_role: Federal health ministry; sets requirements for technical documentation of medical devices, including disclosure of AI technologies in software as a medical device.

organizations.ai_governance_role: National standards body; approves GOST R national and PNST preliminary national standards on AI, developed through Technical Committee 164 'Artificial Intelligence'.

organizations.ai_governance_role: Central bank and integrated financial-market regulator; issues AI consultation papers, the AI Code of Ethics for the financial market, AI information-security recommendations and the rules for the AI experimental legal regime on the financial market; runs the fintech regulatory sandbox.

organizations.name: Federal Service for Technical and Export Control
organizations.ai_governance_role: FSTEC of Russia: federal authority for technical protection of information; its information-protection requirements for state information systems include rules on the use of AI.

organizations.name: President of the Russian Federation
organizations.ai_governance_role: Head of state; approves the National AI Development Strategy by decree (Decree No. 490 of 2019, amended by Decree No. 124 of 2024), formed the Presidential Commission on AI Technology Development (Decree No. 116 of 2026) and signs federal laws, which are published on kremlin.ru.

organizations.name: Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation
organizations.ai_governance_role: Bicameral federal parliament (State Duma and Federation Council); adopts federal laws on AI, including Federal Law No. 243-FZ of 2026 on supporting AI technology development, the experimental legal regimes law (No. 258-FZ) and the Personal Data Law (No. 152-FZ).

organizations.name: Government of Moscow
organizations.ai_governance_role: Executive authority of the federal city of Moscow; issues the city's resolutions on AI experiments (computer vision in healthcare) and implements the experimental AI legal regime set by Federal Law 123-FZ.
